name: feature.production.nodes
description: Production Intelligence node pack — build the production context (rank team + vendors by channel fit) and generate a production plan (per-asset execution route internal/contractor/agency/hybrid with budget & timeline), grounded in the ranked context via the run-scoped provider. Persists the plan via ctx.features.production and emits a production.plan artifact.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Production: Build Context
nodes.description: Ranks the internal team (Profiles) + the Vendor Directory against a brief's enabled channels into a token-capped prompt context over ctx.features.production. Inputs: { orgId, channels }. Output: { relevantCategories, teamCapabilitySection, vendorSection, rankedMembers, rankedVendors, gaps }.

nodes.label: Production: Generate Plan
nodes.description: Generates a production plan (per-asset execution route + budget + timeline + capability assessment) grounded in the ranked production context, via the run-scoped ctx.callAI. Persists the plan via ctx.features.production.savePlan and emits a production.plan artifact. Inputs: { orgId, channels, assets?, briefId?, provider?, model? }. Output: { plan, artifact }.
